meta.title: GitHub inbox
meta.description: Lets the agent keep watch over your repository the way a maintainer would: it reads the GitHub repositories a session subscribes to, keeps the events that concern you — failed checks, reviews waiting for you, issues assigned to you, comments that mention you, open security alerts, and pull requests that conflict with the base branch — and puts them in front of the agent in its own turn, opening one by itself when the session is idle and the fact matters, so a broken check gets fixed and a review request gets reviewed without waiting for you. A chip in the status row lists them and switches delivery, message clearing and subscriptions. Read-only; waking is opt-in and gated, and reading while idle happens only in the mode that can wake — the default queue-only mode makes no request while idle.
